summary: State the measured sum of lead, cadmium, mercury and hexavalent chromium for this packaging and how it was tested. The sum must not exceed 100 mg/kg for the packaging and for each component (Art 5(4)).
填写该包装铅、镉、汞、六价铬四项含量之和的检测值及检测方法。包装及每个组件的四项之和均不得超过 100 mg/kg（Art 5(4)）。
terms: Sum of four heavy metals
四项重金属之和
Pb + Cd + Hg + Cr(VI) concentrations added together, in mg/kg (= ppm).
Pb + Cd + Hg + Cr(VI) 浓度相加，单位 mg/kg（= ppm）。
Packaging component
包装组件
Any individual part of the packaging, incl. inks, adhesives, labels and closures.
包装的任何独立部分，包括油墨、胶黏剂、标签和封口。
logic: Art 5(4) sets the limit; Art 5(6) requires the TD to demonstrate compliance.
Art 5(4) 设定限值；Art 5(6) 要求在技术文档中证明符合。
The limit applies per component, so every component in the BOM needs coverage — by test or supplier evidence.
限值按组件适用，因此 BOM 中每个组件都需覆盖——通过检测或供应商证据。
The platform cross-checks supplier heavy-metal certificates for each component (supplier library).
平台会核对供应商库中每个组件的重金属证书。
info: Numeric result (sum, mg/kg) — use the highest component result if tested separately.
数值结果（总和，mg/kg）——若分别检测，取组件中最高值。
Method (e.g. EN 13657 digestion + ICP-OES / ICP-MS; XRF screening only as supplement).
方法（如 EN 13657 消解 + ICP-OES / ICP-MS；XRF 仅作筛查补充）。
minimum: Result entered as a number ≤ 100 mg/kg
已填写数值结果且 ≤ 100 mg/kg
Test report or supplier evidence for every component
每个组件均有检测报告或供应商证据
recommended: Upload the original report under C04-70
在 C04-70 上传报告原件
Report ≤ 24 months old from an ISO/IEC 17025 accredited lab
报告不超过 24 个月，来自 ISO/IEC 17025 认可实验室
steps: Collect the heavy-metal reports or supplier declarations for every BOM component (incl. inks and adhesives).
收集 BOM 每个组件（含油墨、胶黏剂）的重金属报告或供应商声明。
Take the highest sum of Pb+Cd+Hg+Cr(VI); enter it as a number, e.g. '< 50' or '41'.
取四项之和的最高值；以数字填写，如“< 50”或“41”。
Enter the method as written in the report.
按报告原文填写方法。
Upload the report(s) here or under C04-70, then run 'Check my entry'.
在此或 C04-70 上传报告，然后点击“检查我的填写”。
good: Result '< 50'; method 'EN 13657 + ICP-OES'; report HM-2026-014 covers card, ink and adhesive.
结果“< 50”；方法“EN 13657 + ICP-OES”；报告 HM-2026-014 覆盖纸卡、油墨与胶黏剂。
bad: A report for the board only, inks not covered.
报告只覆盖纸板，未覆盖油墨。

help: Sum in mg/kg. '< 50' is fine if below the detection limits.
总和，单位 mg/kg。低于检出限时可写“< 50”。
msg: 请以 mg/kg 填写数字。

help: Digestion and instrument as stated in the report.
按报告填写消解方法与仪器。

summary: Only for food-contact packaging: show PFAS stay below the Art 5(5) limits. If the packaging is not food-contact, select 'Not applicable' and write why.
仅适用于食品接触包装：证明 PFAS 低于 Art 5(5) 限值。若包装不接触食品，选择“不适用”并写明理由。
terms: PFAS
PFAS（全氟/多氟烷基物质）
Substances with at least one fully fluorinated methyl or methylene carbon atom (definition in Art 5(5)).
至少含一个全氟化甲基或亚甲基碳原子的物质（定义见 Art 5(5)）。
Targeted analysis vs total fluorine
靶向分析与总氟
Targeted analysis measures listed PFAS individually; total fluorine screens all fluorine incl. polymeric PFAS.
靶向分析逐个测定所列 PFAS；总氟筛查全部氟，包括聚合物 PFAS。
logic: Art 5(5) applies only to food-contact packaging, from 12 Aug 2026.
Art 5(5) 仅适用于食品接触包装，自 2026-08-12 起。
Limits: 25 ppb any single PFAS; 250 ppb sum of targeted PFAS; 50 ppm total PFAS incl. polymeric.
限值：任一 PFAS 25 ppb；靶向 PFAS 总和 250 ppb；含聚合物的总 PFAS 50 ppm。
If total fluorine > 50 mg/kg, the supplier must on request prove how much is PFAS vs non-PFAS fluorine (Art 5(5)(c)).
若总氟 > 50 mg/kg，供应商须应要求证明 PFAS 与非 PFAS 氟各占多少（Art 5(5)(c)）。
info: Applicability decision consistent with C04-18 and the project profile.
适用性判断与 C04-18 及项目概况一致。
Food-contact: results for targeted PFAS (ppb) and total PFAS / total fluorine (ppm) with report number.
食品接触：靶向 PFAS（ppb）及总 PFAS / 总氟（ppm）结果及报告编号。
minimum: N/A: rationale written / food-contact: test report attached
N/A：已写理由 / 食品接触：已附检测报告
recommended: Upload the PFAS report or supplier declaration under C04-71
在 C04-71 上传 PFAS 报告或供应商声明
steps: Confirm with C04-18 whether the packaging touches food.
通过 C04-18 确认包装是否接触食品。
Not food-contact → select 'Not applicable' and write one sentence why.
不接触食品 → 选择“不适用”并写一句理由。
Food-contact → request targeted PFAS + total fluorine testing (or supplier proof) and enter the values.
接触食品 → 申请靶向 PFAS + 总氟检测（或供应商证明）并填写数值。
good: Applicable; targeted PFAS each < 10 ppb, sum < 50 ppb, total fluorine 12 mg/kg — report FCM-PFAS-2026-007.
适用；靶向 PFAS 各 < 10 ppb，总和 < 50 ppb，总氟 12 mg/kg——报告 FCM-PFAS-2026-007。
Not applicable: transport case, no contact with food (product is sealed in its sales pouch).
不适用：运输外箱，不接触食品（产品密封在销售袋中）。
bad: 'PFAS free' supplier letter without method or values for food-contact packaging.
食品接触包装仅有供应商“不含 PFAS”信函，无方法和数值。

note.ph: Not food-contact: … / Targeted PFAS … ppb; total F … mg/kg (report …)
help: Reason for N/A, or the values with report number.
N/A 理由，或数值及报告编号。

summary: Say whether this packaging unit is in contact with food. This decides whether the PFAS limits (Art 5(5)) apply.
说明该包装单元是否接触食品。这决定 PFAS 限值（Art 5(5)）是否适用。
terms: Food-contact packaging
食品接触包装
Packaging intended to come into contact with food (Regulation (EC) 1935/2004).
预期与食品接触的包装（(EC) 1935/2004 法规）。
logic: Sales packaging of a food usually touches the food; outer cases or shippers usually do not — decide per unit.
食品的销售包装通常接触食品；外箱或运输箱通常不接触——按单元判断。
info: Yes / No per unit, consistent with the project profile.
按单元填写是 / 否，与项目概况一致。
recommended: Keep the food-contact declaration under C04-72
在 C04-72 保存食品接触声明
steps: Select Yes for any unit touching the food directly; No for outer/transport units.
直接接触食品的单元选“是”；外包装/运输单元选“否”。
good: PU-001 pouch: Yes. PU-002 shipper: No — product sealed in PU-001.
PU-001 袋：是。PU-002 运输箱：否——产品密封在 PU-001 中。
bad: Same answer for every unit without thinking about the level.
不考虑层级，所有单元填同一答案。

summary: Upload the original heavy-metal test report (or supplier CoC) and register its number, laboratory, date, scope and result, so the TD can cite it.
上传重金属检测报告（或供应商 CoC）原件，并登记编号、实验室、日期、覆盖范围和结果，供技术文档引用。
terms: CoC (Certificate of Conformity / Compliance)
CoC（符合性证书）
A document by a supplier or lab stating conformity with a stated requirement.
供应商或实验室出具的、声明符合特定要求的文件。
logic: Annex VII 2(f) lists test reports as TD content; this item is their landing place for Art 5(4).
Annex VII 2(f) 将测试报告列为技术文档内容；本项是 Art 5(4) 报告的落点。
The result must agree with C04-16.
结果须与 C04-16 一致。
info: Report number, laboratory, report date, components covered, sum result.
报告编号、实验室、报告日期、覆盖组件、总和结果。
minimum: 已上传报告 / CoC 文件
已填写报告编号与实验室
Scope covers all components incl. inks
覆盖范围含全部组件及油墨
recommended: 报告日期在 24 个月内
steps: Upload the PDF report.
上传 PDF 报告。
Copy number, lab, date and result from page 1.
从第 1 页抄录编号、实验室、日期和结果。
List the components covered.
列出所覆盖的组件。
good: HM-2026-014 · accredited lab · 2026-08-30 · card + ink + adhesive · sum < 50 mg/kg.
HM-2026-014 · 认可实验室 · 2026-08-30 · 纸卡 + 油墨 + 胶黏剂 · 总和 < 50 mg/kg。
bad: Report dated 2021 for a different board supplier.
2021 年、针对其他纸板供应商的报告。

summary: Food-contact packaging: upload the PFAS test report or supplier proof and register its number, issuer, method and values.
食品接触包装：上传 PFAS 检测报告或供应商证明，并登记编号、签发方、方法和数值。
terms: Total fluorine
总氟
Screening of all organic and inorganic fluorine; above 50 mg/kg the PFAS share must be proven on request.
对全部有机和无机氟的筛查；超过 50 mg/kg 时须应要求证明 PFAS 占比。
logic: Evidence behind C04-17; only needed where Art 5(5) applies.
C04-17 背后的证据；仅在 Art 5(5) 适用时需要。
info: Report/declaration number, issuer, method, values in ppb / ppm.
报告/声明编号、签发方、方法、数值（ppb / ppm）。
minimum: 已填写方法与数值（食品接触）
recommended: Targeted analysis and total fluorine both reported
同时报告靶向分析与总氟
steps: Upload the report; copy number, issuer, method and values.
上传报告；抄录编号、签发方、方法和数值。
good: FCM-PFAS-2026-007 · lab · targeted LC-MS/MS + total fluorine (CIC) · each < 25 ppb; total F 12 mg/kg.
FCM-PFAS-2026-007 · 实验室 · 靶向 LC-MS/MS + 总氟（CIC）· 各 < 25 ppb；总氟 12 mg/kg。

summary: Food-contact packaging: upload the declaration of compliance required by the food-contact legislation for the material, and register number, issuer and scope.
食品接触包装：上传材料适用的食品接触法规所要求的符合性声明，并登记编号、签发方和适用范围。
terms: Declaration of compliance (food contact)
食品接触符合性声明
Supplier statement under Regulation (EC) 1935/2004 and specific measures (e.g. (EU) 10/2011 for plastics).
依据 (EC) 1935/2004 及具体措施（如塑料 (EU) 10/2011）出具的供应商声明。
logic: This is food-contact law, not PPWR; it supports the Art 5(5) applicability decision.
此为食品接触法规而非 PPWR；用于支持 Art 5(5) 适用性判断。
info: Declaration number, issuer, materials and conditions of use covered.
声明编号、签发方、所覆盖的材料和使用条件。
recommended: Conditions of use (food type, time, temperature) match the product
使用条件（食品类型、时间、温度）与产品一致
steps: Request the declaration from the material supplier; upload; copy number, issuer, scope.
向材料供应商索取声明；上传；抄录编号、签发方、范围。
good: FCM-DoC-2026-007 · laminate supplier · PET/PE, fatty foods, 10 days at 40 °C.
FCM-DoC-2026-007 · 复合膜供应商 · PET/PE，脂肪类食品，40 °C 10 天。
bad: Declaration for a different laminate structure.
针对不同复合结构的声明。

summary: Optional: a one-page statement that summarises the Art 5 evidence (heavy metals, PFAS, food-contact) for TD §6. Recommended, not legally required — the EU DoC already covers Art 5.
可选：用一页声明汇总 Art 5 证据（重金属、PFAS、食品接触），供 TD §6 引用。属于建议做法，非法定要求——欧盟 DoC 已涵盖 Art 5。
logic: Good practice to keep TD §6 conclusion and evidence IDs in one place.
将 TD §6 结论与证据编号集中的良好实践。
info: Statement number, issuer, date, basis (evidence IDs), conclusion.
声明编号、出具方、日期、依据（证据编号）、结论。
minimum: Statement number, issuer and date entered
已填写声明编号、出具方与日期
steps: Summarise the results of C04-16/70 and C04-17/71; cite their evidence IDs; sign and upload.
汇总 C04-16/70 与 C04-17/71 的结果；引用其证据编号；签署并上传。
good: SOC-PPWR-2026-001: Art 5(4) sum < 50 mg/kg (PU-001-TST-001); Art 5(5) not applicable — not food-contact.
SOC-PPWR-2026-001：Art 5(4) 总和 < 50 mg/kg（PU-001-TST-001）；Art 5(5) 不适用——非食品接触。
bad: A statement that claims compliance without citing evidence.
声明符合但未引用任何证据。
